articles.title: 'Time doesn't heal': Parents of October 7 attacks victim Aner Shapira

articles.title: Three years after October 7 attacks, Israel's economy shows its strength

The country's tech sector – specifically its defence startups – has played a big part in this performance but challenges, notably demographic ones, are on the horizon. Meanwhile, the destruction caused by Israel's war in Gaza has reduced GDP per capita in the Palestinian enclave by 83 percent and reconstruction plans there have yet to begin.
